properties.name: brooklyn_1767
properties.map: Plan of the City of New York in North America, surveyed in the years 1766 & 1767 — Bernard Ratzer (engr. T. Kitchin, publ. Jefferys & Faden, London 1776)
properties.georeferencing: NYPL Map Warper control points (NYC Space/Time Directory dump mapwarper.objects.ndjson, map 15264), thin-plate spline; residual = cross-validated RMS over 150 of 153 points (few of them on the Long Island side)
properties.note: The ferry village only ('Brookland Ferry'): the houses Ratzer draws at the landing and along the ferry road for about 400 m, and the group south-west of the landing under the Heights. The church village of Brooklyn (about Fulton St and Hoyt St, 1.5 km inland), Bedford and the farms are scattered houses, not built-up blocks, and are left out. A sheet join crosses the map just south of the village.
properties.method: hand-traced on the warped map (free vertices: none of today's street lines existed except the ferry road, today's Old Fulton St)
